name: Drawer
summary: Side-panel overlay with backdrop, right and left placement variants, close control, body/footer regions, open state, and accessibility behavior requirements.

anatomy.name: overlay
anatomy.description: Backdrop layer that dims content behind the drawer.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Fixed side panel that owns placement, surface, shadow, and slide motion.

anatomy.name: header
anatomy.description: Optional top region for title and close affordance.

anatomy.name: close
anatomy.description: Optional close control styled for hover and focus-visible states.

anatomy.name: body
anatomy.description: Scrollable primary content region inside the drawer.

anatomy.name: footer
anatomy.description: Optional bottom action or summary region.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Default drawer width and viewport bounds.

states.name: closeHover
states.description: Pointer hover state on the close control.

states.name: closeFocusVisible
states.description: Keyboard focus indicator on the close control.

behavior.name: visibility
behavior.description: The overlay and drawer are hidden by default and become visible when is-open is applied to both elements.

behavior.name: placement
behavior.description: The default placement slides from the right; the left variant changes the resting and open transform direction.

behavior.name: dialogSemantics
behavior.description: The drawer should expose modal dialog semantics when it blocks interaction with the page behind it.

behavior.name: focusManagement
behavior.description: Opening the drawer moves focus inside it, traps tab navigation while open, and restores focus to the trigger on close.

behavior.name: dismissal
behavior.description: The drawer must provide a visible close mechanism and should close on Escape.

properties.name: placement
properties.description: Side from which the drawer enters.

properties.name: open
properties.description: Controls visibility of both the drawer and its backdrop. Consumer targets still own focus management and dismissal behavior.

accessibility: Use role="dialog" and aria-modal="true" when the drawer blocks page interaction.
Provide a programmatic name with aria-labelledby or aria-label.
Trap keyboard focus inside the drawer while it is open.
Return focus to the trigger element when the drawer closes.
Close on Escape and provide a visible close control.
Use the left placement only when it matches the target reading direction or product pattern.

web.notes: Implemented by class composition in components/css/layout.css; behavior must be provided by the consuming target.

shopify.notes: Shopify Liquid can render drawer structure while theme JavaScript controls visibility and focus behavior.
